ranked.headline: Computational models infer gene regulation from single-cell and spatial transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers extend spatial and single-cell transcriptomic inference to co-expression, spatiotemporal dynamics, and missing tissue…

ranked.headline: Multimodal deep learning predicts protein, ligand and drug interaction properties
ranked.summary: Pretrained protein and chemical language-model embeddings now feed 3D and graph encoders across binding, toxicity and drug-interaction prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Mutational, epigenomic and regulatory data probe cancer origin, repair and instability
ranked.summary: Single-cell and mutational spectra data now link genomic instability to tumor origin, repair gene roles and regulatory elements.

ranked.headline: Index and storage layers enabling scalable analysis of compressed genomic data
ranked.summary: Recent work reports million-genome k-mer search on laptops and indexed gzipped FASTQ parsing without modifying the original files.

ranked.headline: Calibrated fine-mapping and context-resolved QTL methods refine complex-trait association
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend fine-mapping, regulatory variant prioritization and single-cell QTL mapping to resolve genetic effects.

ranked.headline: Language models are steered to generate protein, RNA, and codon sequences
ranked.summary: Generative models now impose target properties during sequence generation rather than only predicting them from sequence.

ranked.headline: Explicit alignment recovers shared structure across slices, batches, and modalities
ranked.summary: Recent work integrates unpaired single-cell, spatial, and multi-slice data, where alignment separates shared structure from context-specific variation.

ranked.headline: Tokenization and patching strategies reshape DNA language model representations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints vary tokenization, architecture, and sequence length for DNA models, while a new benchmark tests five foundation models zero-shot.

ranked.headline: Refined force fields and ensembles resolve conformational energetics in proteins
ranked.summary: Improved all-atom force fields, PTM-aware coarse-grained parameters, and crystallographic ensembles now tie conformational states to measured thermodynamics.

ranked.headline: Control policies and network models fitted to neural and kinematic measurements
ranked.summary: Network control and AdEx-based models are now fitted against EEG, fMRI, and connectome data, testing inferred parameters against measured neural dynamics.

ranked.headline: Genomics tools validated against external criteria and large benchmark datasets
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications test sequence-analysis tools against explicit external criteria across metagenomic, viral, and bacterial genome datasets.

ranked.headline: Graph and higher-order structure used to infer disease-relevant molecular features
ranked.summary: Four preprints and one published study now apply network and higher-order structure to expression and perturbation data for disease inference.

ranked.headline: Computational models link nanopore structure, sequencing, and ionic current prediction
ranked.summary: Nanopore sensing now draws on AlphaFold-based pore models, error-free consensus pipelines, and ionic current predictors for noncanonical bases.

ranked.headline: Graph-aware and differentiable tools for population-scale genotyping, phasing, and…
ranked.summary: Population-scale variant data now demand reproducible tools that handle pangenome graphs, ancestry, and selection statistics in reusable software.

ranked.headline: Statistical corrections for sequencing noise refine transcription and transcript-usage…
ranked.summary: Scale misspecification, quantification ambiguity and noisy coverage profiles challenge error control and inference in sequencing analyses.

ranked.headline: Computational methods recover protein quantities from confounded imaging and omics data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers address background, heterogeneity, and differential expression limits in multiplexed imaging and mass spectrometry proteomics.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools unify ML, statistics and curation for biomarker and target discovery
ranked.summary: Recent releases package biomarker selection, LLM-driven gene set expansion and metadata harmonization into accessible, runnable platforms.

ranked.headline: Deep learning links microscopy and histology images to cellular and molecular readouts
ranked.summary: Current preprints and publications combine generative augmentation, foundation-model benchmarking, and histology-to-transcriptome prediction with classic…

ranked.headline: Long-read and transcriptome data resolve isoform-level annotation and NMD escape rules
ranked.summary: Long-read genomes and transcriptome-integrated annotation now make isoform-level structure and regulatory rules directly testable.

ranked.headline: Coupling stress inference and cell-matrix mechanics across tissue and multiscale models
ranked.summary: Recent work quantifies absolute tissue stresses and links cell-ECM mechanochemistry to epithelial lifetime and cell detachment across scales.

ranked.headline: Harmonized antibody-antigen interaction data and interface tools for binding studies
ranked.summary: Large harmonized interaction datasets and interface analysis tools now enable systematic comparison of antibody and antigen binding structures.

ranked.headline: Stochastic noise and molecular sequestration shape emergent gene expression distributions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply stochastic modeling and spectral Koopman methods to link microscopic reaction rules with emergent cellular distributions.

ranked.headline: Computational frameworks for omics data: flux, deconvolution, and microbiome analysis
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous subjects, platforms, and correlated data streams demand analysis tools that go beyond standard omics workflows.

ranked.headline: Computational methods for interpreting genomic variants from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Variant interpretation from sequencing data is moving toward calibrated, phenotype-aware, and artifact-controlled models for clinical use.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and explicit parameter rules refine structural analysis tools
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications benchmark homodimer calling, library grouping, BGC similarity, and ddG features against explicit criteria.

ranked.headline: Simulation and explicit observation models link data to infection processes
ranked.summary: Likelihood-free methods are being matched to specific data types, as preprints pair ABC-SMC and neural posterior estimation with mechanistic epidemic models.

ranked.headline: Structure-based computation guides ligand, antibody, and enzyme design decisions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply structure-based simulation and AI-guided prioritization to ligand, antibody, and enzyme optimization.

ranked.headline: Linkage, indels, and slightly deleterious mutations shape genome evolution models
ranked.summary: Recent models quantify how genetic linkage, arbitrary-length indels, and slightly deleterious variants shape sequence evolution across genomes.

ranked.headline: Negative-set design and data context govern reliability of binding predictions
ranked.summary: Recent TCR-epitope benchmarking and antibody affinity maturation comparisons show that negative-set sourcing and feature choice drive predictive reliability.

ranked.headline: Latent models decompose longitudinal microbiome and compositional omics data
ranked.summary: Joint dimension reduction, clustering and tensor models are being built to recover structure from temporal and compositional omics data.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level assemblies resolve introgression and hybrid genome history across taxa
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level genome assemblies across tinamous, whiptails, Drosophila, and a primate now allow direct tests of introgression and demographic history.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings reveal motifs, local structure, and remote homology
ranked.summary: Pretrained protein language model embeddings are now probed, pooled, and discretized for motif, structural, and homology tasks from sequence alone.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked tools for plasmid, synthetic-tag and feature-extraction sequence analysis
ranked.summary: Recent tools report benchmarks against reference methods for sequence search, single-cell tag counting and biological feature extraction.

ranked.headline: Models of cell size, actin pools, and fungal nuclear density control
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply reduced dynamical models with parameter inference to cell size, actin assembly, and nuclear division.

ranked.headline: Mathematical models link somatic mutations to lifespan and breast cancer incidence
ranked.summary: Quantitative models now treat somatic mutation burden and menopausal shifts in mutant-cell dynamics as explicit constraints on aging and cancer risk.

ranked.headline: Probes and explanations expose confounders and hidden features in biological models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply sparse autoencoders, layer probing, and distillation to explain protein and genomic deep learning models.

ranked.headline: Retrieval-conditioned embeddings extend protein search, inverse folding, and docking
ranked.summary: Learned embeddings combined with retrieval or structural representations are now applied to generative design and complex docking, not only database search.

ranked.headline: Models assign function to microproteins and divergent archaeal and bacterial proteins
ranked.summary: Deep learning and protein language models now recover functional content from smORFs, divergent enzymes and archaeal elements that standard annotation misses.

ranked.headline: Lipids, electrostatics and ligands tune conformational energetics of membrane proteins
ranked.summary: Atomic-resolution studies of AE1, CFTR, TAS2R14 and KcsA now tie conformational energetics to specific lipid, ion and electrostatic contacts.

ranked.headline: Generative and optimization-based methods now design RNA sequences for 3D folds
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool extend RNA inverse design from secondary structure to tertiary, pseudoknotted, and origami assemblies.
